clue.text: Petty cash in USA

definitions.meaning: trivial or small-time, of little worth
American slang for a quarter dollar, 25 cents

explanation.definitionFit: A cheap or small-time thing is called two-bit, and American slang counts a quarter as two bits of money.

clue.text: Endless paraphernalia required for poacher's craft

indicators.note: endless says the final letter of the word for paraphernalia is cut off

parts.note: trappings are accessories or paraphernalia

explanation.surface: A list of the kit a poacher needs to ply his illicit trade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Endless' removes the last S from TRAPPINGS.
explanation.definitionFit: A poacher's skill lies in snaring game, so setting snares is his craft.

clue.text: Townee — not a foundation-member?

definitions.meaning: at Eton College, boys who are not scholars on the foundation live in town boarding houses and bear this name

explanation.definitionFit: The Latin word for town gives a name for a townsman, used at Eton for pupils who are not foundation scholars (those are Collegers).

clue.text: It is clean maybe, but quite stiff

indicators.note: maybe suggests the letters of the preceding words could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: Something that is clean but nevertheless rather rigid.
explanation.definitionFit: Something without stretch or give is rigid, quite stiff.

clue.text: Pretended to be moved

explanation.definitionFit: Feigned airs are affected, and a person touched emotionally has been affected too.

clue.text: At liberty to come in and purchase from independent business

parts.note: free means at liberty
to enter is to come in
purchase in the sense of leverage or grip is prise

explanation.surface: Freedom to step inside a shop and buy from a small independent trader.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Purchase' looks like buying but means a lever's hold, PRISE (or prize).
explanation.definitionFit: Private commerce free from state control is the economic system of independent business.

clue.text: Remove traces of age, point by point

parts.note: an era is an age
S, south, is a compass point
E, east, is another compass point

explanation.surface: Smoothing away the signs of ageing one spot at a time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'point by point' gives two compass points side by side, S and E.
explanation.definitionFit: To wipe out is to obliterate every mark, removing all traces of something.

clue.text: Where onlookers have standing in housing row

definitions.meaning: the standing area of a football ground where spectators watch

explanation.definitionFit: Football stands with standing room are the terraces, and a street of joined houses is also called a terrace.

clue.text: Small inflatable partly superseding hydroplane

indicators.note: partly says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A rubber boat partly replacing a speedboat.
explanation.definitionFit: A small rubber boat that is blown up with air is an inflatable craft.

clue.text: It is mainly connected with restoration of power

definitions.text: It is mainly connected with restoration of power

parts.words: It is mainly connected with restoration of power
parts.note: a device plugged into the mains that slowly tops up a battery's power

explanation.definitionFit: A low-current device that keeps a battery charged from the mains restores its power.

clue.text: Fruitful source of temptation

parts.note: the fruit-bearing plant in Eden from which Eve was tempted

explanation.definitionFit: In popular tradition the forbidden fruit in Eden grew on this orchard plant.

clue.text: Old priest, breaking an oar, might get a rod instead

indicators.note: breaking the words an oar puts their letters in a new order

explanation.surface: A biblical priest who breaks an oar might be given a rod as a replacement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'breaking' rearranges ANOAR. The tail alludes to the biblical rod that budded, a plant also named after him.
explanation.definitionFit: The brother of Moses was the first high priest of the Israelites.

clue.text: Name Irish writer with an unfinished column

definitions.text: Name Irish writer with an unfinished column

parts.words: Name Irish writer with an unfinished column
parts.note: the Irish poet whose surname Colum is column missing its last letter; the clue asks for his first name

explanation.walkthrough: The poet Colum's surname is COLUMN without its N; the answer is his Irish forename.
explanation.definitionFit: An Irish male forename, a form of Patrick, borne by the poet Colum.

clue.text: Seer was hated at first — nonsense!

parts.note: an eye is a seer, the thing that sees

indicators.note: at first takes only the opening letter of the word hated

explanation.surface: An exclamation that a prophet was disliked from the start is rubbish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Seer' suggests a prophet but is just the organ that sees.
explanation.definitionFit: Talk meant to deceive or impress is humbug, rubbish, nonsense.

clue.text: Musical piece has Number Ten's backing

indicators.note: backing says the word ten is read from right to left

parts.note: ten, taken as written

explanation.surface: A tune that has the support of Downing Street.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Number Ten' looks like Downing Street, the Prime Minister's residence, but splits in two; 'backing' turns only the second word round.
explanation.definitionFit: A composition for nine instruments or voices is a piece of music.

clue.text: Dropped issue, having acted like a lout

definitions.meaning: gave birth to a brood of young, as animals do
scattered rubbish in public, as a yob does

explanation.definitionFit: An animal that bore a brood of young has given birth, and a yob who strews rubbish about has done the same in another sense.

clue.text: Skinny imp cried, upset after leaving Mile End

indicators.note: end picks the final letter of mile
upset jumbles the letters of the words before it

explanation.surface: A thin little rascal wept, distressed after quitting a part of East London.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mile End' is a district in London's East End, but here gives E, the end of 'Mile'; 'upset' rearranges IMPCRIED with E.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to the outer layer of the body, the skin, so skinny in its literal sense.

clue.text: Greek author deposited about a pound on a marble one

indicators.note: about says the word for deposited goes round the pound sign

parts.note: to put something is to deposit it
L, from Latin libra, is the abbreviation for pound
Marble Arch is a famous London monument, so a marble one is an arch

explanation.surface: A Greek writer put down a pound coin on a marble slab.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' sets ARCH after PLUT; MARBLE ARCH is a landmark at the west end of London's Oxford Street.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek biographer wrote the Parallel Lives.

clue.text: Kind of racing where bumping is allowed

definitions.text: Kind of racing where bumping is allowed

parts.words: Kind of racing where bumping is allowed
parts.note: motor racing with modified ordinary saloons, where contact is part of the sport

explanation.definitionFit: Motor sport in which modified saloons race and crash into each other.

clue.text: Initially the price for liberating Light Division

indicators.note: initially takes the first letter of the following word

parts.note: a ransom is the price paid to free a captive

explanation.surface: A kidnapper's demand for releasing an army regiment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Light Division' looks like the army regiment, but means a bar dividing a window (a light).
explanation.definitionFit: The horizontal crossbar separating panes of a window is a divider of its lights.

clue.text: Perfect plan followed by novice

parts.note: an idea is a plan
L, the learner plate, stands for a novice

explanation.surface: A flawless scheme followed by a beginner.
explanation.definitionFit: Something flawless is the model of excellence, perfect.

clue.text: Safe seat for a throw-out, one hopes

definitions.text: Safe seat for a throw-out, one hopes

parts.words: Safe seat for a throw-out, one hopes
parts.note: the pilot's seat that blasts out of a jet in an emergency, hoped to land him safely

explanation.definitionFit: A device that throws something out; in an aircraft its seat launches the pilot clear.

clue.text: This ugly woman would need advance publicity to make headway

indicators.note: the definition word would need extra letters in front to become the word for headway, so those letters are taken away

parts.note: progress is headway
PR, public relations, is advance publicity

explanation.surface: A plain woman needs good press coverage to get on.
explanation.walkthrough: A reverse-style clue: 'would need' says the ugly woman lacks the publicity letters that would turn her into headway.
explanation.definitionFit: A female monster of folklore is a hideous woman.

clue.text: Splendid article about a Spanish city

indicators.note: about says the word for splendid wraps round the letter a

parts.note: grand means splendid
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A grand piece on a city in Spain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts A inside GRAND, and the article A follows.
explanation.definitionFit: The Andalusian city of the Alhambra is in Spain.

clue.text: The sort of language any artist may resort to

indicators.note: resort read as re-sort means the letters are sorted again into a new order

parts.note: RA, Royal Academician, is an artist

explanation.surface: Any artist may fall back on a certain kind of language.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resort' is re-sort, rearranging ANY with RA.
explanation.definitionFit: The term once named the Indo-European family of languages.

clue.text: Put in again for medical treatment after dance

indicators.note: after says the medical treatment follows the dance

parts.note: a reel is a Scottish dance
ECT is electroconvulsive therapy

explanation.surface: Sent back to hospital for treatment after a dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Put in' suggests admitting to hospital but means voting back into office.
explanation.definitionFit: To vote someone back into office is to return them to power.

clue.text: Attempt it by ear?

indicators.note: by ear says the letter names are to be spoken

parts.note: it means sex appeal, abbreviated SA

explanation.surface: Have a go at playing something without the music?
explanation.walkthrough: Spoken, the letters S and A sound out the answer. 'by ear' suggests playing without sheet music.
explanation.definitionFit: A try is an attempt, an old sense of the word.

clue.text: Great confusion about some fuel store

indicators.note: confusion means the letters of the words around it are mixed up

explanation.surface: Chaos surrounding a quantity of fuel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'confusion' rearranges GREAT with SOME; 'about' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A large tank holding town gas is a fuel store.

clue.text: It's a sort of house-not a school

parts.note: a semi is a semi-detached house
nary, as in nary a one, means not a

explanation.surface: Someone insisting a building is a kind of house rather than a school.
explanation.walkthrough: SEMI is a British house sharing one wall with its neighbour.
explanation.definitionFit: A college training priests or ministers is a school.
